reason: A persona-driven UX analysis plugin that reviews supported frontend source code and optionally rendered browser flows to identify, explain, and prioritize user-experience issues without automatically modifying code.

summaries.zh: 一个以用户角色为基础分析前端源代码和可选浏览器流程、发现并解释用户体验问题并提出优化建议的插件。
summaries.en: A persona-driven plugin that analyzes frontend source code and optional browser flows to identify, explain, and prioritize user-experience issues with optimization suggestions.

capabilities: Reads React, TypeScript, JavaScript, Vue, and CSS-related source files
Analyzes source and styles for UX issues using static evidence
Optionally inspects rendered pages, screenshots, and interactive flows in a browser
Persists UX glossary findings to a project file
Generates optimization suggestions and observation-led prompts without automatic code changes
